exercises.q: Он изучал ___ (берберская морфология, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He studied Berber morphology.
exercises.why: **морфология → морфологию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия — declines like DLI's армия: A. армию. Ending -я → -ю.  **берберский → берберскую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with морфологию). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русская: A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. морфология · морфологии · морфологии · морфологию · морфологией · морфологии; pl. морфологии · морфологий · морфологиям · морфологии · морфологиями · морфологиях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

A possessive — declines like DLI's мой / наш. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. атака · атаки · атаке · атаку · атакой · атаке; pl. атаки · атак · атакам · атаки · атаками · атаках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: Зачем объявлять ___ (такая мера, acc. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: Why announce such a measure?
exercises.why: **мера → меру** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  **такой → такую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with меру). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русская: A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. мера · меры · мере · меру · мерой · мере; pl. меры · мер · мерам · меры · мерами · мерах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
